authority: OWNER-BATTERY-CHAMPIONSHIP-03 §1; the owner, 2026-10-12 (Test Lead session): "the grain is the Test Engineer's measured screening standard error, rounded up to the nearest 0.5% (minimum 0.5%)"
rounding: each entry: its measured SE rounded UP to a 0.005 step, floor 0.005
lookup: PLT-08 uses the ONE entry whose `match` equals the deployment: its rule name, the published score section and, when the rule has a registered score term, that term's candidate and registry_sha256; where an entry gives `rule_digest`, the deployment's rule digest must equal it too. No match, or more than one: SEALED_UNTIL_GRAIN (fail closed).
new_rule: a newly adopted rule or score candidate (e.g. a v9 or v10 pick) gets its own measured entry, as a new file version, before it goes live; until then the lookup refuses
display_rule: displayed = (1 + grain)^k, k an integer, rounded toward the WORSE side by the entry's sense so the display never overstates: lower_is_better -> k = ceil(ln(score) / ln(1 + grain)); higher_is_better -> k = floor(ln(score) / ln(1 + grain))
update_rule: a coldkey's displayed value changes only when a submission's grid value is at least one grid step better than the coldkey's displayed best (lower_is_better: k_new <= k_best - 1; higher_is_better: k_new >= k_best + 1); otherwise 'no improvement beyond the grain'
convention: a display convention under the owner's grain decision (OWNER-BATTERY-CHAMPIONSHIP-04 section 3), not a new threshold; the per-coldkey noise floor is the Test Lead's display ruling under the same decision, not a new threshold

entries.score: the pooled mean per-case error on the pooled screening cases

entries.rule_digest_note: not given: the deployed v3 rule carries the deployment's own score term, whose bytes are not in the repository (the template digest covers its REGISTERED_BY_DEPLOYMENT placeholder); the operator may add the deployed digest in a later version
entries.sense_source: carbon/battery/exam.py rule v3-bank-sched: the registered candidate's score, higher is better (OWNER-BATTERY-SCORE-CANDIDATE-01)
entries.score: the registered score a^0.5 q^0.5 on the pooled screening cases and the active windows' design questions
entries.evidence_strength: thin: 10 public members with EV4 development decisions, 9 public scenarios; member spread P10-P90 1.743615-11.615765 %. Remeasure on PUBLIC-DEV-DECISIONS-01's public run, and from scored submissions after the cutover; each is a new file version

file_lookup: PLT-08 reads the highest-numbered screening-grain-vN.json in this folder; older versions are history

noise_floor.ruling: the Test Lead, 2026-10-12, on the v3 entry's member spread (median 2.5 %, P90 12 %): keep the median grid; add a per-coldkey noise floor
noise_floor.step: step = max(grain, own_se_rounded), where own_se_rounded is the coldkey's OWN screening SE (own_se below) on the scored cases of the submission being considered, rounded UP to a 0.005 step
noise_floor.update_rule: a coldkey's display changes only when the submission's score beats the coldkey's displayed best by MORE than `step`, relatively (lower_is_better: displayed_best / score - 1 > step; higher_is_better: score / displayed_best - 1 > step) AND its grid value is at least one grid step better (the top-level update_rule); the new display is the grid value rounded toward the worse side; otherwise 'no improvement beyond the grain'

own_se.v2-bank-sched: sd(per-case errors) / mean(per-case errors) / sqrt(n), over the submission's n pooled scored cases
own_se.v3-bank-sched: 0.5 * sqrt((SE_E / (1 + E))^2 + (SE_R / (1 + R))^2): E the mean per-case error over n scored cases, SE_E = sd(errors) / sqrt(n); R the mean design regret over m design questions, SE_R = sd(question regrets) / sqrt(m) (the delta method for score = a^0.5 q^0.5, a = 1/(1+E), q = 1/(1+R))

noise_floor.minimum_rule: no first display and no update until the submission's screening score rests on at least `min_cases` scored cases (and, under a rule with a design leg, `min_design_questions` design questions); below it the coldkey's display stays as it is (or SEALED_UNTIL_GRAIN when it has none)
noise_floor.min_basis: one full pooled screening set (3 active windows x 98 cases; 3 x k = 8 design questions), the least data a coldkey's own SE can rest on. A registered candidate value; adopting a different one is the Test Lead's call
noise_floor.never: own_se never lowers the step below the grain, and never exposes a per-case or per-window value
